title: Paris: the wellpleased pleaser.
html_source:
Internal narrative.
Paris, a man, decided a beauty contest between three Gods: Aphrodite, Hera and Athena.

he awarded it to Aphrodite because she promised him Helen :

Helen was then kidnapped starting the Trojan war.
